works.description:
Over 1500 students study at Puthunagar Muslim Higher Secondary School, which comes under Palakkad Sub District. A school bus is highly essential for this school.
I am sanctioning the amount to purchase a Tata bus from GeM - with a seating capacity of 27+1, complete the entire work, and make it travel-worthy. The details of the bus are given below.
